Yuvraj Samra leads the charge in a dominant win!
Brescia Lions cruised to an 8-wicket victory over Napoli Knights in Match 3 of 2026!
Napoli Knights posted 93 on the board before Yuvraj Samra's unbeaten 65 off 31 balls powered Brescia Lions to a successful chase!
